key_insight: RLVR can drive unbounded language drift in chain-of-thought reasoning, especially when the task requires behaviors not already present in the base model.
engineering_relevance: For frontier LLM post-training, improving CoT monitorability may require accepting a tradeoff with reward and task performance.
method: Theoretical proof that RLVR optimization pressure allows unbounded language drift.
Contrast with supervised fine-tuning, which does not permit the same drift behavior.
Empirical analysis of RLVR on novel reasoning tasks where the target behavior is not in the base model.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports both theoretical results and empirical demonstrations showing drift emerges during RLVR on novel reasoning tasks.
watch_item: Attempts to constrain language drift may also constrain expected reward, so mitigation could reduce post-training performance.
paper_title: On Language Drift during RLVR Post-Training
